register: # SOURCE: Solinteg 'Hybrid Inverter MODBUS RTU Protocol' v00.02 (vendor PDF, 2022-12-06) - the same Gen3 register layout used by Wattsonic. Every address, type and scale below was checked against that document and matches the Wattsonic Gen3 transcription at smarthome.exposed.

# DEVICE FAMILY: a-TroniX AX hybrid inverters (AKKU SYS GmbH) are reported (TapHome, Homey, evcc) to be rebadged Wattsonic Gen3 units. That clone relationship is NOT yet confirmed by a hardware test of an AX unit; a-TroniX publishes no register document of its own.

# SERIAL: Modbus RTU on the EMS RS-485 port, 9600 8N1 (vendor default), slave id 1-247 (vendor gives no default; Wattsonic units commonly ship as 247). Modbus TCP: port 502, unit 255. All reads use FC03. Addresses are the 0-based on-wire addresses (vendor section 2.3.1); a 1-based tool such as QModMaster needs +1.

# BYTE ORDER: big-endian (vendor section 2.2.3). 32-bit values (U32/I32) occupy two consecutive registers, high word first = the app default ABCD, so no Register_Endian adjustment is needed. Raw values are scaled by the vendor 'accuracy' column: 10 -> 0.1, 100 -> 0.01, 1000 -> 0.001, except power in 'kW accuracy 1000' which is raw watts.

# NOT COVERED: 53500-53523 'BMS data for EMS' block (written BY an EMS, not inverter telemetry); 28000-28015 grid-protection limits; 50200-50211 EMS power scheduling; Table 3.2 model names (10008: high byte = inverter type, low byte = model).
# WRITABLE: every row is R in this file by design. The vendor marks 20000, 25000, 25100, 25103 and the 5xxxx rows as read/write. Older a-TroniX Gen2 (WTS) units use a different 1xxxx-5xxxx map.
